description_en: Queries the number of vulnerability fixes used by pay-as-you-go users
description_zh: 查询按量付费用户已使用漏洞修复次数
name: DescribeFixUsedCount

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the member accounts (Alibaba Cloud accounts) in the resource folder.
You can invoke the [DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
资源目录成员账号ID（阿里云账号）。
调用[DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: resource_directory_account_id

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request and can be used to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

UsedCount.description_en: The number of vulnerability fixes used

UsedCountCn.description_en: The number of vulnerability fixes used in the Chinese mainland
UsedCountCn.description_zh: 中国区域已使用漏洞修复次数

UsedCountSg.description_en: The number of vulnerability fixes used in regions outside the Chinese mainland
UsedCountSg.description_zh: 全球（不含中国）区域已使用漏洞修复次数
